method: Text-free POI analysis of raw YUY2 luma. Edge-spread profiles use the chart's continuous slanted-edge geometry and normalize to measured black/white plateaus. C1 checker histograms normalize luma by those plateaus. This is not a direct HDMI framebuffer measurement.
edge_note: Both edge regions are dark-to-light in the chart raster. The second region label says light-to-dark, but its pixels are also dark-to-light; reverse-polarity ringing was not tested.
